args.command:
cd . && cat > build2.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

# allyl fragment as anion, check stereo with my own priority order
for tag in ['@','@@']:
    smi = f"[CH-]1CC[C{tag}H](Nc2ccccc2)CC=C1"
    m = Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=42)
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
    conf = m.GetConformer()
    # identify atoms
    # idx0 = C1 (carbanion), 1,2 = CH2 (C7,C6), 3 = C5 stereocenter, 4 = N, 11=C4, 12=C3, 13=C2
    st = 3
    at = m.GetAtomWithIdx(st)
    nbrs = {}
    for nb in at.GetNeighbors():
        nbrs[nb.GetIdx()] = nb.GetSymbol()
    print(smi, nbrs)
    N = 4
    C4 = 11   # the CH2 toward the CH=
    C6 = 2
    H = [nb.GetIdx() for nb in at.GetNeighbors() if nb.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
    p = lambda i: np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))
    c = p(st)
    v1,v2,v3,v4 = p(N)-c, p(C4)-c, p(C6)-c, p(H)-c
    # chirality: looking with H away, is N->C4->C6 CCW?
    sign = np.dot(np.cross(v1,v2), v3)
    print('  signed vol (N,C4,C6):', sign, 'H dir dot:', np.dot(v4,(v1+v2+v3)))
EOF

content: Now let me build the complex structure programmatically.

args.command:
cd . && cat > build4.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

xant = Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC1(C)c2cccc(P(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)c2Oc2c1cccc2P(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1")
# ring: V6(carbanion-> will become allyl) ... use [C@H] version (S) determined earlier
allyl = Chem.MolFromSmiles("[CH-]1CC[C@H](Nc2ccccc2)CC=C1")

combo = Chem.RWMol(Chem.CombineMols(xant, allyl))
n1 = xant.GetNumAtoms()
Ps = [a.GetIdx() for a in combo.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='P']
print('P', Ps)
# allyl atoms in combo
V6 = n1+0; V7 = n1+13; V1 = n1+12
print('V6,V7,V1', V6,V7,V1)
pd = combo.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(46))
combo.GetAtomWithIdx(pd).SetFormalCharge(1)
# fix allyl: make V1=V7 single, carbanion neutral
combo.GetBondBetweenAtoms(V1,V7).SetBondType(Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
combo.GetAtomWithIdx(V6).SetFormalCharge(0)
combo.GetAtomWithIdx(V6).SetNumExplicitHs(1)
combo.GetAtomWithIdx(V7).SetNumExplicitHs(1)
combo.GetAtomWithIdx(V1).SetNumExplicitHs(1)
combo.GetAtomWithIdx(V6).SetNoImplicit(True)
combo.GetAtomWithIdx(V7).SetNoImplicit(True)
combo.GetAtomWithIdx(V1).SetNoImplicit(True)
for c in (V1,V7,V6):
    combo.AddBond(pd,c,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
for p in Ps:
    combo.AddBond(p,pd,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
m = combo.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
print('charge', Chem.GetFormalCharge(m))
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'complex_flat.mol')
EOF

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdDistGeom
import numpy as np

m = Chem.MolFromMolFile('complex_flat.mol', removeHs=False)
mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
nat = mh.GetNumAtoms()
Pd=56; Ps=[8,29]; Ct=[42,54]; Cc=[55]
N=46

bm = rdDistGeom.GetMoleculeBoundsMatrix(mh)
def setb(i,j,lo,hi):
    a,b=min(i,j),max(i,j)
    bm[a][b]=hi; bm[b][a]=lo
for p in Ps: setb(Pd,p,2.30,2.40)
for c in Ct: setb(Pd,c,2.18,2.30)
setb(Pd,55,2.05,2.15)
# P...P
setb(Ps[0],Ps[1],4.3,4.7)
# allyl terminal-terminal
setb(42,54,2.35,2.50)
rdDistGeom.DoTriangleSmoothing(bm)

ps = rdDistGeom.ETKDGv3()
ps.randomSeed=0xbeef
ps.useRandomCoords=True
ps.SetBoundsMat(bm)
ps.numThreads=4
cids = rdDistGeom.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh, 10, ps)
print('nconf',len(cids))
res=[]
for cid in cids:
    c=mh.GetConformer(cid)
    p=lambda i: np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(i))
    res.append((cid,[round(np.linalg.norm(p(Pd)-p(x)),2) for x in Ps+Ct+Cc]))
for r in res: print(r)
Chem.MolToMolFile(mh,'complex_3d.mol',confId=int(cids[0]))
# write xyz
c=mh.GetConformer(cids[0])
with open('start.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f"{nat}\nstart\n")
    for i,a in enumerate(mh.GetAtoms()):
        pos=c.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f"{a.GetSymbol()} {pos.x:.4f} {pos.y:.4f} {pos.z:.4f}\n")

content: Now I'll rebuild with the correct ring connectivity (terminus two bonds from the stereocenter).

args.command:
cd . && cat > build9.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdDistGeom
from rdkit.DistanceGeometry import DoTriangleSmoothing
import numpy as np

xant_smi = "CC1(C)c2cccc(P(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)c2Oc2c1cccc2P(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1"

def build(tag):
    # V3 stereocenter -> V2 -> V1(term) = V7(central) - V6(term) - V5 - V4 - V3
    allyl_smi = f"[C{tag}H]1(Nc2ccccc2)CC=CCCC1"
    al = Chem.MolFromSmiles(allyl_smi)
    assert al is not None
    # map: idx0=V3, 1=N, 2..7 phenyl, 8=V2, 9=V1, 10=V7, 11=V6, 12=V5, 13=V4
    nm = {'V3':0,'N':1,'V2':8,'V1':9,'V7':10,'V6':11,'V5':12,'V4':13}
    xa = Chem.MolFromSmiles(xant_smi)
    n1 = xa.GetNumAtoms()
    rw = Chem.RWMol(Chem.CombineMols(xa, al))
    off = {k:v+n1 for k,v in nm.items()}
    Ps = [a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='P']
    pd = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(46)); rw.GetAtomWithIdx(pd).SetFormalCharge(1)
    V1,V7,V6 = off['V1'],off['V7'],off['V6']
    rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(V1,V7).SetBondType(Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
    for c in (V1,V7,V6):
        a=rw.GetAtomWithIdx(c); a.SetNumExplicitHs(1); a.SetNoImplicit(True)
        rw.AddBond(pd,c,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
    for p in Ps: rw.AddBond(p,pd,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
    m = rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
    return m, off, Ps, pd

for tag in ['@','@@']:
    m, off, Ps, pd = build(tag)
    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
    bm = rdDistGeom.GetMoleculeBoundsMatrix(mh)
    def setb(i,j,lo,hi):
        a,b=min(i,j),max(i,j); bm[a][b]=hi; bm[b][a]=lo
    for p in Ps: setb(pd,p,2.28,2.42)
    setb(pd,off['V1'],2.15,2.35); setb(pd,off['V6'],2.15,2.35)
    setb(pd,off['V7'],2.00,2.20)
    setb(Ps[0],Ps[1],4.2,4.8)
    setb(off['V1'],off['V6'],2.30,2.55)
    DoTriangleSmoothing(bm)
    ps = rdDistGeom.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=1234; ps.useRandomCoords=True
    ps.SetBoundsMat(bm); ps.numThreads=4
    cids = rdDistGeom.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh, 8, ps)
    if not cids: print(tag,'fail'); continue
    c = mh.GetConformer(cids[0])
    p=lambda i: np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(i))
    V3=off['V3']
    vN=p(off['N'])-p(V3); v2=p(off['V2'])-p(V3); v4=p(off['V4'])-p(V3)
    det=np.dot(np.cross(vN,v2),v4)
    print(tag,'det',round(det,2),'nconf',len(cids),
          'PdP',[round(np.linalg.norm(p(pd)-p(x)),2) for x in Ps],
          'PdC',[round(np.linalg.norm(p(pd)-p(off[k])),2) for k in ('V1','V7','V6')])
    Chem.MolToMolFile(mh,f'cx_{"A" if tag=="@" else "B"}.mol',confId=int(cids[0]))
